The '''k'Jtari''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They created a [[K'Jtari martial art|martial art]] that influenced its practitioners both mentally and physically. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], their martial art was considered ancient. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Dunan Par'Ell]], who worked as head of security at the [[Ace of Sabres]] resort on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kluistar]], was proficient in it.<ref name="WSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The k'Jtari were created by [[Paul Danner]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]].<ref name="WSV" />
